# Scoped startup controls

`control.cc` consumes the actual generic StartupGate and actual Transit::Root
packet owner. Compile a tiny native C++20/pthread helper in the declared dev shell.
It checks real publication, independent once-only reads, absent LOAD/metadata,
Stop, interrupt failure, retirement and reentrant retirement-to-Stop. A callback
checkpoint or actual owner return determines success; no timeout is a successful
publication.

`control-frontend.cjs` takes the private checkout path and the preserved exact
native Worker error-matrix JSON path. Run with pinned Node 26.13.0 and
`--expose-internals`. It executes the actual candidate Worker preparation over
native Node MessagePort serialization and compares actual hook/original-error
ordering. It deliberately stops before native Kandelo create/adoption; it does
not fabricate a successful child or claim guest graph/packet execution.

`control-initializer.cjs` takes the checkout path. It extracts the actual startup
initializer and uses native primordials/realpath/errors with isolated fixture
globals to check array-like argv, actual file path, eval source selection and
once-only behavior. Actual guest module/realm/eval execution remains unproven.

The parent handoff preserves commands, exact identities and original native
observations separately. No unchanged upstream assertions are rewritten, and no
engine/product build or overall suite is performed by these focused controls.
